dog.description_text: Meet Zeus! Zeus is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rXXlMGvlTv_PjiYEc1HVIZQqE0QtyOZs/view?usp=drive_link Zeus will benefit from a supportive and gentle introduction to his new home. He is a loving and affectionate boy. He loves to play. His foster says his favorite toys are "A scratcher with a rolling ball, a catnip mouse, and a feather on a wand" and "He is an absolute delight and very curious." He enjoys being pet and head scratches and is affectionate. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
